scope: bounded native learning JavaScript waits; actual controller and SQLite host regression tests
changes: Native evaluate Futures consume the remaining existing eight-second admission/readiness/result deadline.
Native event-clear and reflection-progress write Futures have an eight-second timeout.
Timeout fails with unavailable; queue and checkpoint coalescing release, late values cannot mutate snapshots or acknowledge persistence.
Changing native activity mode requires a successful prior checkpoint; a failure preserves the mode and draft.
Actor change between action notification and checkpoint continuation returns stale rather than an unsaved Success.
A narrow native transport port permits injected missing replies without changing the production WebView host or bridge authorization.

checks.command: flutter test --no-pub --concurrency=1 test/features/learning test/learning test/module/module_host_bridge_test.dart test/integration/solo_sync_learning_test.dart --reporter expanded

regression_proof.negative_control: Remove only the native Future timeout while retaining transport seam.
regression_proof.result: Missing native action regression fails with Future not completed; restoring timeout passes.

regression_proof.negative_control: Retain the prior captured-success return when actor changes before checkpoint continuation.
regression_proof.result: Actor notification regression reports expected stale / actual success; separating the actor check passes.

earlier_attempts: First broader concurrent run had two test timeouts: a new outer ten-second test bound and an existing SQLite open thirty-second timeout under host load. Test outer bound now permits the complete eight-second admission plus eight-second result phases. Concurrency-one rerun passed80/80, then final added actor regression sweep passed81/81.
limits: Host native-transport injection is not Android WebView execution.
Platform timeout does not cancel JavaScript already delivered; late Future values are ignored and a subsequent checkpoint retries current live state.
Initial host WebView construction/load and hosted services remain separate gates.
